title: Is this your pencil?
objectives: 会用 Is this your ...? 询问物品归属
会用 Yes, it is / No, it isn't 回答

blocks.title: 问与答
blocks.content: A: Is this your pencil? B: Yes, it is. / No, it isn't. 问东西是不是对方的，用 Is this your ...?

blocks.title: 否定要缩写
blocks.content: is not 常缩写成 isn't。回答否定说 No, it isn't.，不说 No, it is not your.。

exercises.stem: 听一听，选出你听到的句子。
问“这是你的尺子吗？”，怎么说？
exercises.explanation: 疑问句把 Is 提到句首。

exercises.stem: 别人问 Is this your bag? 不是你的，怎么回答？
exercises.explanation: 否定回答用 No, it isn't.。
